heading: About Me
summary: Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building enterprise, business, and e-commerce applications across the complete software development lifecycle. Experienced in requirement analysis, application architecture, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
body: Skilled in building scalable and maintainable solutions, optimizing application performance, implementing secure workflows, and delivering reliable business features. Experienced in taking applications from initial development through production release, collaborating with teams to resolve issues and maintain application quality. Also experienced in mentoring junior developers and interns through technical guidance and project development.
